changes.title: New API endpoint guarded by a permission: POST /api/work-orders/{workOrderId}/lead-change-undo
changes.risk_reason: New capability; confirm the guard matches the permission the PRD/story names.

plain.headline: New protected action: Creating or running work orders › lead change undo
plain.what: There is a new action in the app (creating or running work orders › lead change undo). Only people with one of 14 permissions (for example “Invoicing & Payments — Create & Edit” or “Part Sales — Create & Edit”) can use it.
plain.why: A new feature: make sure the right people can use it and nobody else can.
check: Log in as someone whose role has one of the permissions listed and try it: it should work.
Log in as someone whose role has none of them and try it: it should be blocked, and the button or page should not be shown.

qa_scenarios: API authorisation: call POST /api/work-orders/{workOrderId}/lead-change-undo as a role WITH and a role WITHOUT "Invoicing & Payments — Create & Edit" — expect 2xx and 403.
Front end: the matching screen action is shown only to roles the API allows (front end blocks + back end allows = pass; the reverse is a defect).
Cross-role: try the same call as each system role whose defaults include or exclude the permission.

changes.title: Screens that use "Settings — App" changed
changes.risk_reason: Front end now reads this permission in different places — a screen may show/hide differently.

plain.headline: Screens that depend on “Settings — App” changed
plain.what: The app now shows or hides things based on this permission in a different set of places (before: 16, now: 17).
plain.why: A button, menu item or page may now appear or disappear for some people.
check: Log in as someone with “Settings — App”: the related buttons, menus and pages are shown and work.
Log in as someone without it: they are hidden.

workflows: Screens/code: api/auth/AuthModel.ts, boot/axios.ts, components/office/ts/StaffDialog.vue, components/ts/administration/AdminLeftMenuNav.vue, components/ts/administration/WorkplaceDialog.vue, components/ts/navigation/ProfileMenu.vue (+11 more)
qa_scenarios: Screens: open the screens listed and confirm controls tied to "Settings — App" show/hide/disable correctly for a role with and without it.
Nav: top-level navigation items for the area appear only for roles holding the permission.
